title: Isolated Brazilian tribe emerges amid alarm over threats to group’s way of life
summary_full: Indigenous Awá people of Amazon make contact with villagers and accept food to take back to territoryAbout 20 Indigenous people emerged from isolation in Brazil’s Amazon rainforest, several organizations reported on Tuesday, raising the alarm about increased invasions into the tribe’s territory.According to the NGO Survival International, members of the Awá people, who live in voluntary isolation, arrived on Monday in a village and made contact with a government team in a “historic encounter”.
